n: Many AIs now listen when you speak. Record a voice note on your phone and a small speech model on your own computer can turn it into text in about a minute, so nothing leaves the house. Talking is the fastest way to hand over what is in your head; keep the written copy too, because the transcript is what you and your AI will search later.
